track.name: the track series (Track Diagram)
track.idea: the family's week drawn as a signal box's illuminated track diagram: steel lines on slate boards with a lamp at each stop, drawn only where there is an order (Coming up, To do, the setup steps, the chat); the series began as Signal Box (round 7) and its mimic-line language

changes: bring back the original Phosphor page's light wherever this design shows phosphor: every effect in phosphor_kit.md that fits it, in this design's own terms
the machine's voice as lit phosphor: Vera's words, times and live readouts with a soft halo, while the family's words stay grounded and sharp
glowing dots on the black: the live lamps and status lights as small green points that glow and breathe, and a faint field of phosphor dots where the machine speaks

timetable.name: Night Timetable
timetable.idea: a station at night: Vera's conversation is the line the page hangs from (the question the first stop, the ways to start stops, 'Continue with Vera' the terminus), the chat a timetable with times in the margin, the Next up screen a dot-matrix departure board

changes: a CRT face for the machine's words on the tubes (Workbench, Sixtyfour or Doto, bleed and scanlines light), the family's words in a quiet sans
a stylistic set or character variant of the face (ss01-ss08, cv..), where it has one, for a more distinctive texture
tracking tuned per size: display titles tighter (about -0.02em), small labels and caps looser (+0.04 to +0.08em)

pocket.name: Pocket Timeline
pocket.idea: Home ordered as time on one spine: NOW (the question), then NEXT (the tube), then Coming up, then LATER, with the lists beside it; every page strung along a timeline

changes: the monitors redrawn as illustrations: a detailed period terminal or scope, drawn in SVG, around the green glass
the FamilyDB mark in the bar redrawn in the design's line, keeping its idea (a smiling monitor) and its #6dff9c

figure.name: Figure Ground
figure.idea: the family's operator manual: every section led by a figure drawn from its own data (Status as the wiring of keys and connections with lit ports, the chat as a sequence diagram, To do's due dates on a line with NOW, Home's family tree to Vera to its counts)

changes: turn the companion colour's hue by about -30 degrees, keeping its roles and lightness
redraw the monitors: a different case (inset flush in the page, a flat panel, a deep rounded tube)
true small caps (font-variant-caps: all-small-caps) for labels and eyebrows instead of uppercase

console.name: Flight Console
console.idea: a 1969 flight console: a readout strip across the top (TODAY, PLANS, TO DO, LATE, IDEAS), the coming weeks drawn as a flight plan of hops between stops, an annunciator of lit lamps on Status, a crew board of lamps on To do, a T-minus countdown for setup, a flight-log chat

changes: bring back the original Phosphor page's light wherever this design shows phosphor: every effect in phosphor_kit.md that fits it, in this design's own terms
the radar and her screen at full strength: the sweep's afterglow, glowing blips, and her glyph screen's bloom and scanlines
the green screens as real tubes again: VT323 at three strengths, a third of a pixel of blur, bloom, scanlines, and the curved glass falling into shadow at its corners

switchboard.name: Videotex Switchboard
switchboard.idea: Home as the map of the whole service: every page a cell with its number, a lamp and a count (a videotex sommaire), the question typed on the glass under a cursor, each page opening on the same rack with its own green summary screen

changes: a new mono for the machine and the figures (Geist Mono, Red Hat Mono, Azeret Mono, Fira Code, Spline Sans Mono or Victor Mono)
text-wrap: balance on every heading and pretty on paragraphs, so no line ends on a lonely word
a slashed or dotted zero in the monospaced face, where it has one (font-feature-settings "zero")

yardsticks.r13-idea-1: Desk Terminal, Joined, the main tournament's leader after round 13

donors.r9-idea-4: Signal Lines: Signal Box's rings and tracks on every page, and a page head that holds its title, tabs and actions in one bracket
donors.r7-idea-1: Galley Rack: the Coming up strips the owner said look far better than any other (a date designator block, the title and time, a tabular 'in 3 days' facts column)
donors.r10-mut-4: Flight Deck, Lit: a glass cockpit's colour code (cyan entered, bone data, amber caution, green on), thin screwed faceplates, legends set into the breaks of fine demarcation lines
donors.r10-wild-2: Bench Scope: the coming weeks drawn as glowing pulses on a scope, Ideas in XY mode
donors.r12-wild-4: Single Quote: a title set with its figure in the section's colour and a stacked mono legend, a command path with a blinking cursor, an LED on the current key
donors.r12-mut-2: Long Persistence, Metered: today's spend as a phosphor moving-coil needle meter
donors.r13-wild-1: Phosphor Blueprint: the footer as a drawing's title block, dimension lines for 'in 2 days', a 24px baseline grid
donors.r13-wild-3: Dessau Phosphor: a round phosphor screen holding each page's one live figure, four shapes with four jobs and their legend in the footer, a huge scanlined glowing 'mind'
donors.r13-wild-4: Grid Console: a lit spine down the gutter with a node at each section, section-coloured trails, the only afterglow the judges could see
donors.r13-wild-2: Signal Catalogue: a scope pulse per plan and LED countdown meters
